title: AquaCal real-rig calibration results package (Record B): configuration, reference outputs and run manifest
description:
Results package for the AquaCal 13-camera underwater production rig calibration: the configuration that produced the published numbers, the reference outputs themselves, the archived calibration comparison target, and the run manifest recording the exact software environment. A few megabytes, re-versioned whenever the results change.

Contents:

  • config_paper.yaml — the configuration behind the published results.
  • config_quickstart_not_paper.yaml — the faster quickstart configuration, which does not reproduce the published numbers.
  • reference_calibration.json — the archived calibration used as a comparison target.
  • reference_outputs/ — calibration.json, diagnostics.json, exp2_spatial_errors.csv, interface_ablation_conditioning.npz, reconstruction_errors.csv, reprojection_residuals.csv.
  • run_manifest.json — interpreter, library versions, host and git revision for the run that produced the outputs above.

Supersession notice — please read before comparing numbers. This record supersedes the reference_outputs/ contained in Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.21889922. Record 21889922 is retained as the historical submitted package and still contains the older reference outputs, which do not match the current paper. Any comparison against the published numbers must use the reference_outputs/ in this record, not the ones inside 21889922.

Inputs. These results were computed from the calibration frames published as Record A: __RECORD_A_URL__ . Reproducing them requires both records: the frames from Record A and the configuration from this one.

Provenance. Produced by AquaCal 2.0.1 at git revision 7005a2771aa115e4f4c1284cec7e145739586a4a, Python 3.11.15, NumPy 2.4.6, SciPy 1.17.1, OpenCV 4.13.0 (pinned to a single minor: ChArUco corner detection changes across OpenCV minor versions and moves the published error metrics).

Software: AquaCal.
